answer: A real applicant carries a trellis from a workshop, a sonnet from a ledger, and a river from the kiln's own log — three different keepers, one consistent story. One mask pays 223 POA and waits 3 days; a farm pays 42593 POA and still waits 3 days per mask. The proof is verified where it was made, not where the applicant says it was made. A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Wall mosaicist tessellated pavement seal laid upon the baptistery dome is that proof, written as each tessellated pavement is a measured tessera yield plus a guild signature.
